source.title: SigmaHQ Rules Detections (Compiled from 80 candidate events)

documents.name: Event 7045 - Service Installation
documents.content: Windows Event 7045: A new service was installed. Sigma Detections: Service binary path pointing to %TEMP%, %APPDATA%, %PUBLIC%, or network share; service executing powershell/cmd.exe; service names matching PsExec, RemCom, Cobalt Strike, or random strings. High indicator of lateral movement or persistence.

documents.name: Event 4697 - Service Installation Attempt with Audit
documents.content: Windows Event 4697: A service was attempted to be installed with security auditing. Sigma Detections: Metasploit/Impacket PsExec service installation, malicious credential dumper registration, or obfuscated service names.

documents.name: Event 5145 - Network Share Object Access
documents.content: Windows Event 5145: Detailed network share object check. Sigma Detections: Access to administrative shares (ADMIN$, C$, IPC$) from non-admin accounts, staging executable/batch scripts in SYSVOL or GPO startup directories.

documents.name: Event 4624 - Successful Account Logon
documents.content: Windows Event 4624: An account successfully logged on. Sigma Detections: Metasploit authentication, RottenPotato privilege escalation, anomalous Logon Type 3 (network) or Type 10 (RDP) from untrusted workstations.

documents.name: Event 4663 - Attempt to Access Object
documents.content: Windows Event 4663: An attempt was made to access a securable object. Sigma Detections: Unauthorized processes accessing LSASS or SAM registry keys, WCeaux/Mimikatz activity, accessing ISO mount files.

documents.name: Event 4656 - Handle to Object Requested
documents.content: Windows Event 4656: A handle to an object was requested. Sigma Detections: Access requests to critical security processes (LSASS, Winlogon), SDelete secure file wiping patterns, tampering with Defender registry keys.

documents.name: Event 5136 - Directory Service Object Modified
documents.content: Windows Event 5136: A directory service object was modified. Sigma Detections: Unauthorized changes to Active Directory Group Policy Objects, modification of user SID History, or alteration of sensitive group ACLs.

documents.name: Event 4662 - Operation Performed on Directory Object
documents.content: Windows Event 4662: An operation was performed on an Active Directory object. Sigma Detections: BloodHound/SharpHound mass enumeration of domain objects, DCSync rights exploration, Certificate template enumeration.

documents.name: Event 3008 - Code Integrity / Driver Filter
documents.content: Windows Event 3008: Code integrity driver or print spooler filter warning. Sigma Detections: Unsigned or revoked kernel drivers attempting to load, vulnerable driver exploitation (BYOVD).

documents.name: Event 4657 - Registry Value Modified
documents.content: Windows Event 4657: A registry value was modified. Sigma Detections: Adding Windows Defender exclusions (Exclusions\Paths), NetNTLM downgrade attacks (LmCompatibilityLevel), disabling Sysmon logging channels.

documents.name: Event 4720 - User Account Created
documents.content: Windows Event 4720: A user account was created. Sigma Detections: Creation of hidden user accounts (ending in $), unauthorized local accounts created during off-hours, or accounts created by non-administrative users.

documents.name: Event 16403 - BITS Client New Transfer
documents.content: Windows Event 16403: Background Intelligent Transfer Service (BITS) started a new transfer job. Sigma Detections: BITS downloading from raw IP addresses, uncommon TLDs, or public file sharing domains.

documents.name: Event 5007 - Windows Defender Configuration Changed
documents.content: Windows Event 5007: Windows Defender configuration was altered. Sigma Detections: Exploit Guard tampering, disabling Real-time Protection or Behavioral Monitoring, modifying Antivirus scanning exclusions.

documents.name: Event 33205 - MS SQL Audit Record
documents.content: Windows Event 33205: Microsoft SQL Server audit event. Sigma Detections: Execution of xp_cmdshell extended stored procedure, adding accounts to sysadmin fixed server role, disabling database audit specifications.

documents.name: Event 4625 - Account Failed to Log On
documents.content: Windows Event 4625: An account failed to log on. Sigma Detections: Multiple consecutive logon failures (Status 0xC000006A: bad password, 0xC0000234: locked out), Metasploit automated login attempts, Ruler Exchange exploit.

documents.name: Event 854 - AppX Package in Staging
documents.content: Windows Event 854: AppX deployment server package staged. Sigma Detections: AppX package staged from suspicious user directories (%TEMP%, %APPDATA%) or downloaded from public file sharing sites.

documents.name: Event 4738 - User Account Modified
documents.content: Windows Event 4738: A user account was modified. Sigma Detections: Adding SID History to user account (persistence), enabling weak DES encryption on Kerberos accounts, configuring Kerberos unconstrained delegation.

documents.name: Event 5379 - Credential Manager Access
documents.content: Windows Event 5379: Access to Windows Credential Manager or reading encrypted archive files. Sigma Detections: Suspicious extraction of credentials from Windows Vault or opening password-protected archives in Outlook.

documents.name: Event 4776 - NTLM Authentication Validation
documents.content: Windows Event 4776: The domain controller validated credentials using NTLM. Sigma Detections: Pass-the-Hash authentication surges, failed NTLM validation attempts across domain accounts.

documents.name: Event 4661 - SAM or LSA Object Access
documents.content: Windows Event 4661: A handle to SAM or LSA object was opened. Sigma Detections: Password policy enumeration by non-admin users, net.exe recon activity, LSA secret discovery.

documents.name: Event 4768 - Kerberos TGT Request
documents.content: Windows Event 4768: A Kerberos Authentication Ticket (TGT) was requested. Sigma Detections: AS-REP Roasting (pre-auth disabled), PetitPotam coerced authentication against Domain Controller.

documents.name: Event 5156 - WFP Connection Permitted
documents.content: Windows Event 5156: Windows Filtering Platform permitted an outbound network connection. Sigma Detections: Outbound Kerberos from unusual hosts, RDP reverse tunneling, remote PowerShell sessions (WinRM 5985).

documents.name: Event 4719 - System Audit Policy Changed
documents.content: Windows Event 4719: System audit policy was modified. Sigma Detections: Disabling audit logging for logon, privilege use, or process creation categories to blind SOC detection.

documents.name: Event 4769 - Kerberos Service Ticket (TGS) Request
documents.content: Windows Event 4769: A Kerberos Service Ticket (TGS) was requested. Sigma Detections: Kerberoasting activity (ticket encryption type 0x17 requested for high-value SPNs like MSSQLSvc).

documents.name: Event 2004 - Windows Firewall Rule Added
documents.content: Windows Event 2004: A rule has been added to the Windows Defender Firewall exception list. Sigma Detections: Inbound rule added for binaries in %TEMP% or %APPDATA%, rule created via WMI (WmiPrvSE).

documents.name: Event 2071 - Windows Firewall Rule Modification
documents.content: Windows Event 2071: Windows Defender Firewall rule settings were modified. Sigma Detections: Firewall port opening for remote administrative tools, backdoor listener enablement.

documents.name: Event 2097 - Windows Firewall State Transition
documents.content: Windows Event 2097: Windows Firewall rule operational status changed. Sigma Detections: Disabling firewall enforcement for public or private network profiles.

documents.name: Event 2008 - Firewall Setting Changed / KDC Cert Mapping
documents.content: Windows Event 2008: Firewall global configuration modified or KDC certificate used without strong mapping. Sigma Detections: Potential certificate-based authentication coercion or firewall profile degradation.

documents.name: Event 7036 - Service State Changed
documents.content: Windows Event 7036: A service entered the stopped or running state. Sigma Detections: Windows Defender (WinDefend) stopped, remote access tools (AnyDesk, TeamViewer) started unexpectedly.

documents.name: Event 28115 - Shell Core Suspicious Package
documents.content: Windows Event 28115: Shell core package registration. Sigma Detections: Installation of unauthorized or suspicious AppX packages designed to persist across user sessions.

documents.name: Event 8004 - AppLocker Blocked / NTLM Brute Force
documents.content: Windows Event 8004: AppLocker prevented an application from running or NTLM brute force threshold exceeded. Sigma Detections: Execution of blocked script/binary in temp path, NTLM authentication floods.

documents.name: Event 400 - PowerShell Engine Started / AppX Package
documents.content: Windows Event 400: PowerShell engine lifecycle started or full-trust AppX package installation. Sigma Detections: Malicious AppX package deployments, unexpected background PowerShell engine initialization.

documents.name: Event 401 - PowerShell Engine Stopped / AppX Failed Signing
documents.content: Windows Event 401: PowerShell engine stopped or AppX package deployment failed signing requirements. Sigma Detections: Attempted execution of unsigned or forged packages.

documents.name: Event 5447 - WFP Filter Modifying EDR Silencer
documents.content: Windows Event 5447: A Windows Filtering Platform filter was modified. Sigma Detections: EDR-Silencer or NoFilter hacktools manipulating WFP to block security agents from communicating with cloud telemetry.

documents.name: Event 4673 - Sensitive Privilege Service Called
documents.content: Windows Event 4673: A privileged service was called. Sigma Detections: Non-system process attempting to call LsaRegisterLogonProcess (mimikatz DCSync setup) or loading user-mode drivers.

documents.name: Event 4648 - Logon Attempt with Explicit Credentials
documents.content: Windows Event 4648: A logon was attempted using explicit credentials. Sigma Detections: Abuse of RunAs to execute tools under a domain admin account, lateral movement to domain controllers.

documents.name: Event 4699 - Scheduled Task Deleted
documents.content: Windows Event 4699: A scheduled task was deleted or disabled. Sigma Detections: Attackers removing backup/security monitoring tasks to avoid automated detection or forensic recovery.

documents.name: Event 4898 - AD CS Certificate Template Vulnerable
documents.content: Windows Event 4898: Active Directory Certificate Services template configuration altered. Sigma Detections: Modification of certificate templates to introduce ESC1/ESC2 vulnerabilities (Enrollee Supplies Subject).

documents.name: Event 4899 - AD CS Template Access Control Changed
documents.content: Windows Event 4899: Active Directory Certificate Services template security altered. Sigma Detections: Granting standard users enrollment or write permissions on sensitive certificate templates.

documents.name: Event 2003 - Firewall Setting Change / USB Plugged
documents.content: Windows Event 2003: Windows Firewall setting changed or USB device plugged into endpoint. Sigma Detections: Unauthorized USB storage attached to sensitive endpoints.

documents.name: Event 1121 - Windows Defender ASR Rule Triggered
documents.content: Windows Event 1121: Windows Defender Attack Surface Reduction (ASR) blocked an action. Sigma Detections: ASR blocked credential stealing from LSASS, blocked process creation from PSExec/WMI commands.

documents.name: Event 1116 - Windows Defender Malware Detected
documents.content: Windows Event 1116: Windows Defender detected malware or potentially unwanted software. Sigma Detections: Real-time protection alert, AMSI detected obfuscated PowerShell/VBScript payload.

documents.name: Event 5013 - Defender Tamper Protection Triggered
documents.content: Windows Event 5013: Windows Defender Tamper Protection detected and blocked an attempt to disable security features. Sigma Detections: Direct registry tampering to disable Microsoft Defender Antivirus.

documents.name: Event 129 - Task Scheduler LOLBIN Execution
documents.content: Windows Event 129: Task Scheduler task execution from suspicious locations. Sigma Detections: Scheduled task executing living-off-the-land binaries (LOLBINs) from %TEMP% or public folders.

documents.name: Event 201 - Remote Access Tool / Sysinternals Execution
documents.content: Windows Event 201: App runtime execution of remote administration tools. Sigma Detections: Unauthorized ScreenConnect client execution, Sysinternals tool deployment by unauthorized users.

documents.name: Event 1040 - MSI Package Installation from Suspicious Path
documents.content: Windows Event 1040: Windows Installer (MSI) installed an application. Sigma Detections: msiexec executing an installer hosted on remote web servers or located in %TEMP%.

documents.name: Event 1042 - MSI Package Termination
documents.content: Windows Event 1042: Windows Installer transaction completed. Sigma Detections: Installation of rogue software or remote management agents via MSI.

documents.name: Event 1034 - Application Removed / DHCP Error
documents.content: Windows Event 1034: Application uninstalled or DHCP client configuration failure. Sigma Detections: Uninstallation of endpoint protection agents or network spoofing indicators.

documents.name: Event 1033 - RMM Software Installed / DHCP Config
documents.content: Windows Event 1033: Application installed or DHCP config updated. Sigma Detections: Silent installation of unauthorized RMM agents (Atera, AnyDesk) used by ransomware operators.

documents.name: Event 1001 - Application Crash / Crash Dump Created
documents.content: Windows Event 1001: Windows Error Reporting crash dump generated. Sigma Detections: Exploitation attempts causing security services (MsMpEng, LSASS, Spoolsv) to crash repeatedly.

documents.name: Event 325 - ESENT Database NTDSUtil Abuse
documents.content: Windows Event 325: Extensible Storage Engine (ESENT) database access. Sigma Detections: Abuse of ntdsutil.exe to create an IFM (Install from Media) dump of ntds.dit to steal all domain password hashes.

documents.name: Event 1000 - Application Error / Process Crash
documents.content: Windows Event 1000: Application error log. Sigma Detections: Crash of critical Windows security processes (lsass.exe, msmpeng.exe, svchost.exe) indicative of memory corruption or exploit attempts.

documents.name: Event 18456 - MS SQL Server Logon Failed
documents.content: Windows Event 18456: Login failed for SQL Server user. Sigma Detections: High-frequency authentication failures targeting the SQL 'sa' account from external or untrusted IP addresses.

documents.name: Event 7023 - System Service Terminated with Error
documents.content: Windows Event 7023: The Service Control Manager reported that a service terminated with an error. Sigma Detections: Unexpected termination of endpoint protection or logging services.

documents.name: Event 104 - System Event Log Cleared
documents.content: Windows Event 104: The System log file was cleared. Sigma Detections: Adversaries clearing event logs via wevtutil or PowerShell to destroy forensic traces.

documents.name: Event 157 - AppX Packaging Signature Invalid
documents.content: Windows Event 157: AppX package signature verification failed. Sigma Detections: Tampered or forged AppX packages attempted to be loaded.

documents.name: Event 1007 - System Certificate Exported
documents.content: Windows Event 1007: Certificate Services client exported a private certificate key. Sigma Detections: Theft of machine authentication certificates or code signing keys.

documents.name: Event 40300 - Hybrid Connection Manager Service Active
documents.content: Windows Event 40300: Hybrid Connection Manager operational event. Sigma Detections: Unauthorized cloud tunneling established out of an enterprise network.

documents.name: Event 40301 - Hybrid Connection Relay Established
documents.content: Windows Event 40301: Hybrid connection relay established. Sigma Detections: Persistent cloud relay channels created by internal threat actors.

documents.name: Event 40302 - Hybrid Connection State Terminated
documents.content: Windows Event 40302: Hybrid connection relay disconnected. Sigma Detections: Teardown of external relay connections.

documents.name: Event 8003 - AppLocker Warning (EXE)
documents.content: Windows Event 8003: AppLocker audit alert: executable would have been prevented from running. Sigma Detections: Executable running from temp directory during audit enforcement.

documents.name: Event 8006 - AppLocker Warning (Script)
documents.content: Windows Event 8006: AppLocker audit alert: script would have been prevented from running. Sigma Detections: Unauthorized .ps1, .vbs, or .bat script executed.

documents.name: Event 8021 - AppLocker Warning (MSI)
documents.content: Windows Event 8021: AppLocker audit alert: MSI installer would have been prevented from running. Sigma Detections: Installation of unauthorized software packages.

documents.name: Event 8024 - AppLocker Warning (DLL)
documents.content: Windows Event 8024: AppLocker audit alert: DLL would have been prevented from running. Sigma Detections: Rogue DLL injection or sideloading attempt.

documents.name: Event 8007 - AppLocker Enforced Block (Script)
documents.content: Windows Event 8007: AppLocker blocked a script from running. Sigma Detections: Malicious script blocked by policy in enterprise environment.

documents.name: Event 8022 - AppLocker Enforced Block (MSI)
documents.content: Windows Event 8022: AppLocker blocked an MSI package from running. Sigma Detections: Unauthorized software installation blocked.

documents.name: Event 8025 - AppLocker Enforced Block (DLL)
documents.content: Windows Event 8025: AppLocker blocked a DLL from loading. Sigma Detections: Blocked DLL sideloading attempt.

documents.name: Event 603 - Unsigned Package Installation
documents.content: Windows Event 603: Unsigned AppX package installation attempted. Sigma Detections: Attempt to deploy untrusted application package bypassing policy.

documents.name: Event 441 - AppX Deployment Policy Block
documents.content: Windows Event 441: AppX deployment blocked by administrative policy. Sigma Detections: Attempted installation of disallowed Windows store package.

documents.name: Event 442 - AppX Package License Failure
documents.content: Windows Event 442: AppX package license check failed. Sigma Detections: Sideloaded malicious package rejected by OS licensing engine.

documents.name: Event 453 - AppX Deployment Blocked by AppLocker
documents.content: Windows Event 453: AppX deployment rejected by AppLocker policy. Sigma Detections: Sideloaded payload prevented from deploying.

documents.name: Event 454 - AppX Registration Blocked
documents.content: Windows Event 454: AppX package registration blocked. Sigma Detections: Application blocked by system policy.

documents.name: Event 412 - AppX Deployment AppLocker Enforced
documents.content: Windows Event 412: AppX deployment blocked by AppLocker package rules. Sigma Detections: Enforcement against unauthorized package deployment.

documents.name: Event 5137 - Directory Service Object Created
documents.content: Windows Event 5137: A directory service object was created. Sigma Detections: Coerced authentication via rogue DNS object creation in Active Directory.

documents.name: Event 5441 - WFP Filter Installed by EDR Silencer
documents.content: Windows Event 5441: A Windows Filtering Platform filter was added. Sigma Detections: EDR-Silencer hacktool adding persistent filters to suppress EDR alerting.

documents.name: Event 5038 - Code Integrity Invalid Hash
documents.content: Windows Event 5038: Code integrity determined that the image hash of a file is not valid. Sigma Detections: Modified system binary, patched driver, or injected DLL.

documents.name: Event 6281 - Code Integrity Page Hash Failure
documents.content: Windows Event 6281: Code Integrity determined that page hashes of an image file are not valid. Sigma Detections: In-memory or on-disk tampering with driver binaries.

documents.name: Event 6416 - External Device Recognized
documents.content: Windows Event 6416: A new external device was recognized by the system. Sigma Detections: Suspicious HID device (Rubber Ducky / BadUSB) or unauthorized USB storage.

documents.name: Event 4800 - Workstation Locked
documents.content: Windows Event 4800: The workstation was locked. Sigma Detections: Activity occurring while workstation was supposedly locked (anomalous logon or script execution).

documents.name: Event 4658 - Handle to Object Closed (SDelete)
documents.content: Windows Event 4658: The handle to an object was closed. Sigma Detections: File wiping patterns (Sysinternals SDelete) where handles are repeatedly opened and closed with zero bytes.
